_note: Thresholds marked provisional are engineering defaults to be confirmed by the project owner; none was supplied in the handoff. 'basis' states where each number comes from.

rules.name: ModelNotLoaded
rules.basis: Binary health gauge: any value below 1 means the provider is not ready.
rules.runbook: Check GET /api/v1/health/ready and startup logs (event=startup_failed). Verify frozen artifact SHA-256 vs app/backend/model_loaders/frozen_manifest.json and, in registry mode, the MLflow DB/artifact paths. Do not swap models without Person 1 approval.

rules.name: High5xxRate
rules.runbook: Inspect logs for event=request_failed and error_code INVALID_MODEL_OUTPUT / MODEL_UNAVAILABLE; re-run tests/test_api_*.py against the running build.

rules.name: InferenceFailures
rules.basis: The frozen model is deterministic on validated input; any inference exception is abnormal.
rules.runbook: Capture exception_type from logs; reproduce with tests/phase9/person3; check scikit-learn/numpy versions against requirements.txt.

rules.name: NonFinitePrediction
rules.basis: API contract requires one finite prediction (INVALID_MODEL_OUTPUT otherwise).
rules.runbook: Stop serving the affected variant; compare against frozen artifact via tests/phase9/person3/test_reproducibility_and_parity.py.

rules.name: PredictLatencyP95High
rules.basis: provisional: ~18x the single-predict p95 (28 ms) measured on the reference laptop; batch-100 (~2.5 s p50) is not covered by this rule (see reports/phase9/monitoring/API_METRICS_REPORT.md).
rules.runbook: Check CPU saturation and n_jobs contention (ExtraTrees uses n_jobs=-1); check batch sizes (max 100).

rules.name: InputRejectionSpike
rules.basis: provisional: >20% of requests rejected by validation suggests a client/schema mismatch.
rules.runbook: Inspect /metrics solarselect_api_errors_total{code}; compare client payload to GET /api/v1/model/schema. Do not loosen validation to silence it.

rules.name: GovernanceRejections
rules.basis: Counts prospective-roof requests blocked by the pending lag policy (HTTP 409).
rules.runbook: Expected until the lag policy is decided. Rising counts = demand for the blocked feature; escalate to the policy owner. Never bypass the guard.

rules.name: FeatureDriftAlert
rules.basis: Conventional PSI action level 0.25 (0.10-0.25 = warn). Industry convention, not project-derived.
rules.runbook: Identify features in drift report; check for seasonal shift (training covered 2021-05..2021-12 only), site mix change or upstream bug. Feature drift is not proof of degraded accuracy - confirm with labels. No automatic retraining.

rules.name: PerformanceDegradation
rules.basis: provisional: live MAE >25% above Person 1's held-out MAE (0.905). Requires actual-yield labels.
rules.runbook: Review residuals by site/season; escalate to Person 1 for governed retraining decision. Never auto-promote.
